description: This file defines a Java interface 'CarDao' that specifies data access methods for 'Car' entities, including CRUD operations and a query for all cars.

classes.name: CarDao
classes.description: Interface for data access object managing Car entities with methods for retrieving, adding, updating, and removing cars.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Car entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a Car entity based on its ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Car entity to the data store.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Car entity identified by ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Car entities as a list of maps with string keys and object values.
